Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Armenian

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Armenian
public class Armenian extends Object
Armenian-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_ARMENIAN section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x14.
